query:
query Query( $customerId: String, $memberId: String) {
 loyaltyMemberCampaigns(customerId: $customerId, memberId: $memberId) {
 id 
 assignmentDate 
 contactedDate 
 completedDate 
 documentStatusCode 
 comments 
 createdBy 
 createdOn 
 lastUpdatedBy 
 lastUpdatedOn 
 campaignId 
 customerId 
 campaignName 
 campaignCode 
 startDate 
 endDate 
 status 
 type 
 }
}
